name: io.github.api-freaks/apifreaks-mcp
title: APIFreaks MCP
description: Live APIFreaks APIs for agents: weather, WHOIS, DNS, SSL, domain availability/reputation/typosquatting, IP geolocation and threat intel, screenshots, PDF, currency, commodities, VAT/IBAN/SWIFT, email/phone validation, geocoding, geography, timezone, zipcode, scraping, and user-agent. Modules are opt-in via ENABLE_MODULES. Call list_modules to see what is covered and enabled, and to get a paste-ready enable line if something is missing — then restart.

environmentVariables.name: APIFREAKS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your APIFreaks API key — get one free at apifreaks.com

environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_MODULES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated modules to register as live tools (e.g. ip-intelligence,whois,dns,domain,weather). If unset, only list_modules is available — call it for coverage and a paste-ready ENABLE_MODULES line, then restart. Available: ip-intelligence, geocoding, whois, dns, scraper, email-validation, phone-validation, ssl, domain, screenshot, pdf, currency, commodity, financial, zipcode, weather, geography, timezone, user-agent
